verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a single unified `gcloud` CLI reference that covers interactions with the Google Cloud APIs. A non-flagship service, Cloud Billing, has its own REST API reference, and the Cloud APIs are documented for both REST and client-library use. This points to platform-wide reference coverage beyond flagship products, but the pack does not show that every service has consistent reference depth. missing for 10: evidence that reference docs are consistent across the full service catalog, per-service API reference examples beyond Billing and Cloud Run, and independent or hands-on corroboration of documentation consistency.
